name: DOLLARDE
description: DOLLARDE converts a dollar value expressed in fractional notation (e.g., bond prices quoted in 32nds) into a decimal number.
tldr: Converts a dollar price expressed as a fraction into a decimal number.

parameters.name: fractional_dollar
parameters.description: Number expressed as a fraction, such as 1.02 for 1 and 2/16.

parameters.name: fraction
parameters.description: Integer to use in the denominator of the fraction.

howItWorks: DOLLARDE takes the integer part of the input as the whole dollar amount and the decimal part as the numerator over the specified fraction. For example, 1.02 with fraction 16 becomes 1 + 2/16.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Integer part of the input is the whole dollar amount.

commonErrors.fix: Use a non-zero integer for the fraction.
Use an integer value for the fraction.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: DOLLARDE works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between DOLLARDE and DOLLARFR?
faq.answer: DOLLARDE converts a fractional dollar price to decimal. DOLLARFR converts a decimal dollar price to fractional.

faq.question: When is DOLLARDE used?
faq.answer: It is used for bond prices quoted in fractions, such as 32nds or 64ths.
